title: Knock Alloy
prompt: drum n bass, dufry, fred again
description: A designed FM sine bass for drum n bass: a metallic, knocking low-mid voice where the FM index steps through a sequence and the harmonicity rides a separate slow clock, so the timbre never repeats the same way twice. Penv clicks give each note an 808-like knock and a long delay tail smears the metallic edge into space.
